CRM modernisation

How a growing sales team moved from spreadsheets and inboxes to a central CRM with automated follow-ups and a clear view of every opportunity in the pipeline.

Let's Talk All case studies
Sector
Sales
Focus areas
  • CRM
  • Sales automation
Related
CRM solutions · Web application development
Client
Confidential
Overview

Spreadsheets and email work well for a small sales team. As the team grows, they become the reason opportunities slip through the cracks. This business had outgrown its tools: customer information was scattered, follow-ups depended on memory, and nobody had a complete picture of the pipeline. We replaced the patchwork with a central CRM designed around how the team actually sells.

The challenge

What needed to change

Customer information and sales activity were spread across spreadsheets and inboxes, limiting pipeline visibility.

Each salesperson kept their own records in their own way. That made individual work possible, but it made team-wide visibility, consistent follow-up and reliable forecasting very difficult.

What was getting in the way

  • Customer history in too many places

    Contact details, conversations and notes were split between spreadsheets and personal inboxes.

  • Follow-ups that relied on memory

    With no system prompting the next step, timely follow-up depended on each person's own reminders.

  • A pipeline nobody could see in full

    Managers had to ask around to understand which deals were active and where each one stood.

  • Knowledge that left with people

    When responsibilities changed, the history of a customer relationship was hard to hand over.

The solution

What we delivered

We delivered a central CRM with automated follow-ups and clear pipeline tracking.

Every customer, conversation and opportunity now lives in one shared system. The CRM prompts the right follow-up at the right time and shows the whole pipeline at a glance, for each salesperson and for the team as a whole.

Key capabilities

  1. 01

    A single customer record

    Contact details, activity and history in one place, visible to everyone who works with the account.

  2. 02

    Automated follow-ups

    Reminders and next steps triggered automatically, so opportunities keep moving.

  3. 03

    Pipeline tracking

    Every opportunity and its stage visible on one board, for individuals and managers.

  4. 04

    Shared team visibility

    Managers see the state of the pipeline without chasing updates.

  5. 05

    Smooth hand-overs

    Account history stays with the account, not in one person's inbox.

Our approach

What shaped the solution

The priorities that guided the design and delivery.

  • Make the right action the easy action

    Logging activity and moving a deal forward were kept quick, so the CRM fits into the working day instead of adding admin.

  • Automate the reminders, not the relationship

    Automation handles prompts and routine follow-ups; conversations with customers stay personal.

  • Designed for a growing team

    Pipeline stages, roles and views were set up to work as more people join the team.

The impact

What changed for the business

  • Fewer missed follow-ups

    The system now prompts the next step, so opportunities don't depend on someone remembering them.

  • A pipeline everyone can see

    Salespeople and managers share one up-to-date view of every active opportunity.

  • Customer knowledge that stays with the business

    Relationship history is kept in the CRM, making hand-overs and teamwork far simpler.
